top_signals.title: Oil Drops as Traders See Supply Outages Proving Short-Lived
top_signals.summary: Oil fell as physical markets cooled from recent peaks as traders bet some Middle East supply outages would be short-lived.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Suspended Glencore Executive Told Radiant ‘Say Nothing on Email’
top_signals.summary: A senior Glencore Plc executive last year urged counterparts at Radiant World not to communicate by email, according to WhatsApp messages from the company’s head of iron ore seen by Bloomberg News.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: US Air Force to extend service of B-1, B-2 bombers, official says
top_signals.summary: The service lives of the B-1 Lancer and B-2 Spirit will be extended, with their pilots to be some of the first to fly the B-21 Raider.
